lines.t: Verse 1
I walked through the fire, shadows in my mind
Thought I was defeated, running out of time
Then Your voice like thunder cut through all the lies
Now I’m standing fearless, with You by my side
Pre‑Chorus
Every chain is breaking, falling at my feet
I was born for battle, made for victory
Chorus
You make me unshakable, stronger than before
When the darkness closes in, You open up the door
I’ll carry Your light, I’m never going back
With Your name on my heart, I’m ready for the attack
You make me unbreakable, I’m burning with Your fire
Standing in the storm, I’m only rising higher
Verse 2
I remember nights when hope was wearing thin
Echoes of my failures screaming from within
But You wrote a new song over every scar
Now I’m chasing giants, knowing who You are
Every fear is fading, courage floods my veins
I was made to echo the power of Your name
Chorus
You make me unshakable, stronger than before
When the darkness closes in, You open up the door
I’ll carry Your light, I’m never going back
With Your name on my heart, I’m ready for the attack
You make me unbreakable, I’m burning with Your fire
Standing in the storm, I’m only rising higher
Bridge
I won’t bow to the pressure, I won’t run from the fight
You’re the strength in the battle, You’re the blaze in the night
When the world tries to chain me, I remember the cross
What they call a weakness, You have turned into a cause
Breakdown
I am not forgotten, I am not alone
Every step I’m taking, You are on the throne
Fear has lost its power, shame has lost its hold
With Your Spirit in me, I’m a lion, bold
Final Chorus
You make me unshakable, stronger than before
When the darkness closes in, You open up the door
I’ll carry Your light, I’m never going back
With Your name on my heart, I’m ready for the attack
You make me unbreakable, I’m burning with Your fire
Standing in the storm, I’m only rising higher
You make me unstoppable, with every breath I sing
YahuShua, You’re the reason my heart is gonna ring
